description: Research stocks with ValuEdge fair value estimates, margin of safety, fundamentals, comparisons, and screening. Connect your ValuEdge account to let ChatGPT read your portfolio and watchlist, use the stock screener, and get Smart Alerts, so you can ask what your portfolio is worth, how holdings compare with fair value, which stocks deserve further research, and what has changed. ValuEdge provides read-only investment research and does not execute trades.

defaultPrompt: What is Nvidia worth based on fundamentals, and what drives the fair value estimate?
Find high-quality stocks trading at a meaningful margin of safety.
Analyze my portfolio and show which holdings deserve a closer look based on valuation and concentration.
